minutes.headline: Meeting lacked a quorum and was effectively adjourned; members only discussed code implications of reusing town buildings.
minutes.summary: The chair opened the meeting, then discussed feedback from the Building Commissioner and town boards about code upgrades if the town reuses the Brooks house and Town Hall. Members realized they had no quorum, so no business could be decided. Much of the rest concerned members not receiving meeting notifications from the town website, and rescheduling the next meeting to March 6.

public_comment.topic: The APDC representative reported that an APDC member resigned and Nathan Lockwood is expected to go before the select board to replace him; he noted Lockwood's experience with the architectural preservation district.

votes.motion: A member recommended adjourning because there was no quorum; the chair asked for a second and none is evident in the captions.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said bringing the Brooks house up to code for school use would be very expensive for a small building, and code-triggered work could blow the budget.
Members said using Town Hall as a meeting facility would require significant code upgrades and a cost that should be accepted so the building lasts for decades.

decisions.decision: The Feb 20 meeting will be rescheduled because of Presidents' Day; the next meeting is Monday March 6.
The chair will raise the notification and website-subscription problems with Michael Ray and others.

what_happened.line: The Municipal Building Design Committee found it had no quorum, so no business could be decided at the 6 February 2023 meeting.
The chair relayed feedback from the Building Commissioner and town boards on code upgrades that reusing the Brooks house and Town Hall could trigger.
A member said bringing the Brooks house up to code for school use would be costly for a small building and could strain the budget.
The 20 February meeting is rescheduled for Presidents' Day; the next meeting is Monday, March 6, and the chair will raise the notification problems.

why_it_matters: Code-triggered work on the Brooks house and Town Hall is the open cost question in the reuse option, and it bears on any building appropriation voters may later be asked to approve.
Members not receiving meeting notices from the town website is a mechanism that can keep both members and residents from attending, and delays the committee's work.
watch_next: Monday, March 6: the committee's next meeting, where it can act if a quorum is present.
